Fair questions

Then it's not a One-Question Call — it's a Board Room Read (AED 7,500, 5-page written diagnostic on your specific board material, 72h). Book this if you know your question fits in one page. If it doesn't, email me and I'll point you to the right thing.

What kind of questions actually work?

"How should I frame the AI conversation for our board next week?" · "Is our AI vendor selling us the right thing?" · "Where should I draw the line between AI experimentation and governance?" · "How do I answer 'what's our AI strategy' in one paragraph?" · "Which of the Death Spiral patterns is showing up in my org?" — those all fit in one page. "Build me an AI strategy" does not.

What if I'm not happy with the written answer or the call?

If any of the three outcomes above is missing by the end of the call, you don't pay. Full refund, same day, no argument. That's the whole guarantee — no clauses, no clawbacks.

Yes. I don't publish it, I don't share it with a team, and I don't put it into any public example. If you want a mutual NDA before you send it, reply to the payment receipt with the word "NDA" and I'll send one within an hour.

How do I pay?

UAE bank wire transfer to my Mashreq business account — IBAN sent by return email within 15 minutes of your booking. Funds clear same-day on UAE banking days (Sunday–Thursday). Card payments (Stripe) are being enabled and will follow shortly; for this launch week, bank transfer only.

Can I have more than 45 minutes if we're mid-flow?

The call is scoped at 45 minutes because that's the honest amount of time three focused outcomes need. If we're mid-sentence I'll happily go 10 minutes over. If you want a longer engagement, that's the Board Room Read or a Zonar OS™ engagement — different products.
